claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation proximity-to-item predicate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current activation gate vocabulary can express holding/wearing states, but not being within a fixed distance of the source item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawn placement rooted on source item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current spawned-creature range header cannot express nearest-valid-space placement relative to the item instead of the caster.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catalog_ref summon overrides
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Catalog-ref summons cannot currently attach bounded item-specific overrides like language comprehension to the referenced monster stat block.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: optional command metadata on CreatureControl
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface currently forces command range and fallback behavior even when the text does not specify them, which led to conservative placeholders.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count
